jobs.description:
Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 
 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.
 

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

Your Role:
 

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Air Freight Administration
 

 
• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
 
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
 
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities.  
 

Customer Service
 

 
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
 
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
 
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected.  
 

Compliance & Operational Excellence
 

 
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
 
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
 
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
 
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required.  
 

 
 

 

Your Profile:
 

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.
 

Requirements
 

 
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
 
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
 
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
 
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
 
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  
 

Proactive and able to work independently. 
 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
 
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues. 
 

Personal Qualities
 

 
• Customer-focused and service-minded.
 
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
 
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
 
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
 
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

Location: Belgium / Hybrid

Start date: ASAP

Duration: Long-term

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. 

Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.

The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your Role
As a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your Profile
We are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
